what: The edit applied to Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B @ 851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a: per layer a unit direction u (length 2560) and 165 columns. Dose 1 is the chosen edit. The control is a random unit direction orthogonal to both u, same columns, dose scaled by alpha_scale so the weight change has the same Frobenius norm.
formula: W = W0 - dose * alpha_scale * u (u^T W0) on the listed columns of model.language_model.layers.<l>.mlp.down_proj.weight (float32 from bf16, cast back to bf16)
